explanation.missing: Breadth may be estimated from current constituents and unofficial price history when coverage is adequate; otherwise N/A.
explanation.partial: Score is an interval when signals are missing. Green/risk-on is never inferred from absent bearish points.
explanation.rights: Confirm provider display and redistribution permissions before publishing derived data publicly.
explanation.model: Experimental 15-point model; Risk-On threshold unchanged at 0–4. Historical 20-month scores are reconstructed from downloaded market data, not previously recorded historical snapshots. Breadth uses current constituent membership and may suffer survivorship bias. Only full 15/15 sessions enter score ≤4/5 backtest counts; future 5-session ETF price returns are descriptive and overlapping. RSI(14) adds one point; original 50D/200D trend rule is retained; five SMA readings are informational only.
